links.outcome: Reading level of institutional heart failure patient education materials versus recommended 5th-6th grade
links.effect: Institutional PEMs had median Flesch-Kincaid 10th grade (range 8th grade to college freshman); only 13/143 (9.1%) were below 6th grade reading level.
links.quote: There were 13/143 (9.1%) institutional PEMs below the 6 th grade reading level which improved to 33/143 (23.1%) after revision by GPT-4 (p<0.001).

links.outcome: Readability and accuracy of GPT-4 plain-language revision of patient education materials
links.effect: Median grade level fell from 10th to 7th (p<0.001); PEMs below 6th grade rose from 9.1% to 23.1%; none rated less accurate or comprehensive by cardiologist.
links.quote: No GPT-4 revised PEMs were graded as less accurate or less comprehensive compared to institutional PEMs.

screen.reason: Evaluates GPT-4's capability to rewrite patient education materials at a lower reading level with expert evaluation of accuracy, but does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
